name: file-budget
description: Says what a large file read is about to cost, before it happens.

large_file_tokens.title: Large-file threshold (tokens)
large_file_tokens.description: Reads estimated above this get the note. The measured average for a whole-file read is about 2,150 tokens, so 3000 catches the upper half of them.

enforcement.title: Enabled
enforcement.description: 'on' annotates large reads, 'off' disables the hook. Nothing is ever refused.
